label: Mobility traits
description: Extras on top of the base mobility; a card has up to two. Traits marked 'uses a key' are buttons: they count toward the tier's key budget and need their matching mechanic pattern.

terms.label: Amphibious
terms.description: Moves on water as well as land.

terms.label: Climb
terms.source_rule: Code it when the sources show the unit moving up walls, cliffs or buildings that stop other units of its kind, however it holds on (legs, claws, hover thrust). A jump or a flight up or over the obstacle is not climb (see leap; a jetpack is the unit's mobility). Where the trait's rules leave out the unit's class or mobility, code it anyway; the validator lists the break as atypical, which is evidence for relaxing the rule.

terms.label: Crush
terms.description: Runs over smaller units in its path: infantry and small drones; super-heavies also crush light vehicles.

terms.label: Boost
terms.description: A short burst of speed or a dash, on a key, usable anywhere. An order that sends the unit running back to base, like Company of Heroes retreat, is not boost, and its ability links no dash pattern. A boost with no meter, cooldown or other limit is part of the unit's speed (see Speed bands), not this trait.

terms.label: Burrow / submerge
terms.description: Goes underground or underwater to hide or travel; must surface to act.

terms.label: Teleport
terms.description: Blinks a short distance or jumps through space.

terms.label: Transform
terms.description: Switches between two forms, such as walker and jet; the unit records the second form in its modes.

terms.label: Deploy / anchor
terms.description: Stops to enter a stronger stationary mode; must pack up to move.
